correctness.rationale: Using T=|U·e|~Uniform(0,1), Minkowski support additivity gives W=d sqrt(1-T^2)+hT. Direct integrals give m1=pi*d/4+h/2; m2=(2d^2+2dh+h^2)/3; m3=3pi*d^3/16+3d^2h/4+3pi*d*h^2/16+h^3/4. Fix m1=m: h=2m-pi*d/2, and m2 becomes a strictly convex quadratic in d with candidate root sum P=8m(pi-2)/(pi^2-4pi+8). The m3 divided difference [G_m(d)-G_m(P-d)]/(2d-P) has leading coefficient pi(pi^2-12)/64<0 and negative discriminant for m>0: discriminant proportional to -(pi^2-12)*Q(pi), Q(z)=z^4-6z^3+4z^2+36z-64, Q strictly increasing on z>=3 yet Q(22/7)=-104/2401<0. Thus two distinct m2-candidates have distinct m3. The scale-free R(h/d)=m2/m1^2 decreases then increases with minimum at lambda*=(4-pi)/(pi-2), yielding two-moment collisions. Immersion at the quadratic fold follows from nonzero m3 derivative; injective C1 immersion plus compactness implies compact-set Lipschitz inverse. Independently verified integral m3 and divided-difference symbolic coefficients/discriminant with SymPy, plus finite positive collision; these do not replace the all-cylinder algebra.
